answer: Persistent work ledger. Each identity’s history sits in an append-only vault that only grows through verified task completion, and every clone starts empty, so sybils must independently earn reputation from zero. A shared lagoon of reusable proofs lets honest agents reference prior work cheaply while clones pay full recomputation each time. The quill rule ties payouts to signed, countersigned delivery records, making one honest identity cheaper to maintain than many empty ones.
